xiyou_usage: Tang Sanzang calls a team meeting: 'We must align on the mountain today — this mountain has a demonic aura.'
Guanyin gives Wukong three life-saving hairs: 'I have come specially to empower you.'
Tathāgata explains to Wukong: 'The underlying logic of your Havoc in Heaven is actually a misplaced need for personal value and institutional recognition.'
Wukong reports: 'The granularity of the Lion-Camel Ridge demons is too coarse — three fiend kings seized the whole city.'
Wukong to Bajie: 'Your rake is the handle — don't drop it!'
Tathāgata: 'The scripture-fetching project must form a closed loop — all eighty-one tribulations are indispensable.'
Wukong: 'This demon's approach is transformation plus brute force; if that fails, summon reinforcements.'
Tang Sanzang: 'After 14 years of scripture-fetching, we must sediment 5,048 scrolls of true scripture.'
Tathāgata: 'A restless mind and wandering will mean the mental model is not yet corrected — the Tight-Fillet Spell is needed as external intervention.'
Wukong: 'First scout the situation, then summon reinforcements — that is the essence of agile development.'
Guanyin: 'First recruit one disciple as a trial — this is an MVP; expand the team once it works.'
Tathāgata sets the OKRs: O = successful scripture retrieval; KR1 = the Eighty-One Tribulations; KR2 = completed in 14 years; KR3 = 5 people promoted.
Wukong: 'Master, stop trying to send me away — this is called managing up.'
Wukong: 'This time we'll break through Lion-Camel Ridge completely — leave no lingering trouble.'
Wukong: 'The Tight-Fillet Spell has too high a reuse rate — it gets recited every time.'
